display_long_description:
🤖 Welcome to Mecca: Chameleon Props Hunter, a thrilling prop hunt experience that puts your observation skills to the test. Inspired by the classic hide-and-seek game mode, every level is filled with cleverly hidden props waiting to be discovered.

🔍 As the hunter, your mission is simple: search every room, inspect every object, and uncover disguised Mecca Chameleons before the timer expires and turn into a Meccha. If you don't find them in time, the props will turn into the mecca chameleon. What looks like an ordinary 🪑 chair, 💡 lamp, or ☕ coffee mug could be hiding in plain sight.

🧠 Each map is designed to challenge your attention to detail with realistic environments, clever hiding spots (like a super chameleons) and increasingly difficult prop placements. Stay alert, think like a detective, and don't let the Prop super chameleon fool you.

✨ Features

🎯 Hunt hidden props in a unique prop hunt game mode.

🙈 Inspired by classic hide-and-seek gameplay.

🏠 Explore detailed environments filled with clever disguises.

📈 Increasingly challenging levels with new hiding spots.

🎮 Simple controls that are easy to learn but rewarding to master.

🔊 Atmospheric sound effects and satisfying prop discoveries.

🧩 Perfect for players who enjoy puzzle, stealth, and observation games.

🏆 Can you find every hidden prop? Sharpen your eyes, trust your instincts, and prove you have what it takes to complete Mecca: Chameleon Props Hunter, the ultimate prop hunt adventure! 👁️‍🗨️
